text_block_list.name: Tap's Logbook
text_block_list.text:
“We've finally got our own base! Nobody 
can tear us apart now!”

text_block_list.name: Tap's Logbook
text_block_list.text:
We partied hard right away to celebrate 
setting sail. No complaints! It's the 
best!

text_block_list.name: Tap's Logbook
text_block_list.text:
We've got a home base we can return to 
whenever we want. Now then, where shall we 
head next year? Our sea is limitless!
